stories.headline: Anthropic launches Anthropic Institute, internal think tank led by co-founder Jack Clark

key_facts.fact: Anthropic announced the Anthropic Institute on March 11, an internal think tank merging three existing teams — the Frontier Red Team, Societal Impacts group, and Economic Research division — under co-founder Jack Clark, who takes the new title of Head of Public Benefit.
key_facts.excerpt: Anthropic has launched the 'Anthropic Institute,' an internal think tank dedicated to studying how powerful AI affects society, the economy, and security. The institute will be led by co-founder Jack Clark, who is taking on a new role as 'Head of Public Benefit.'

key_facts.fact: The institute starts with approximately 30 people and will research how AI transforms jobs, what new risks emerge from misuse, what 'values' AI systems express, and how humans can maintain control over self-improving AI systems.
key_facts.excerpt: The team consists of around 30 people drawn from three existing research groups. The institute plans to research how AI is transforming jobs, what new risks emerge from misuse, what 'values' AI systems express, and how humans can maintain control over self-improving AI systems.

key_facts.fact: Key hires include Matt Botvinick (formerly Google DeepMind/Yale Law) leading AI and rule-of-law research, Anton Korinek (University of Virginia) studying economic restructuring, and Zoë Hitzig (formerly OpenAI) connecting economic research with model training.
key_facts.excerpt: Matt Botvinick (Google DeepMind/Yale Law) – leads AI and rule-of-law research. Anton Korinek (UVA economics) – studies economic restructuring. Zoë Hitzig (formerly OpenAI) – connects economic research with model training.

key_facts.fact: The launch comes days after Anthropic sued the Trump administration over a supply-chain risk designation barring Pentagon contractors from using its models. Clark stated: 'What we're experiencing...shows how much hunger there is for a larger national conversation.'
key_facts.excerpt: The announcement occurred days after Anthropic sued the Trump administration over a supply-chain risk designation. Clark stated: 'What we're experiencing...shows how much hunger there is for a larger national conversation.'

key_facts.fact: Sarah Heck, formerly Head of External Affairs, takes over the public policy team Clark built and tripled in size during 2025. Anthropic is also opening a Washington D.C. office in spring.
key_facts.excerpt: Sarah Heck takes over public policy role (formerly Head of External Affairs). Anthropic is opening a Washington D.C. office in spring.

stories.headline: Meta unveils four new homegrown AI chips: MTIA 300, 400, 450, and 500

key_facts.fact: Meta announced plans to deploy four new generations of its in-house AI chips — MTIA 300, 400, 450, and 500 — by end of 2027, as part of an effort to diversify hardware sources and reduce reliance on outside chipmakers.
key_facts.excerpt: Meta Platforms Inc. plans to deploy four new generations of its in-house artificial intelligence chips by the end of 2027 as the company turns to custom silicon to help power its rapidly expanding AI workloads.

key_facts.fact: The MTIA 300 is already in production for ranking and recommendation training. The MTIA 400 delivers 400% higher FP8 FLOPS and 51% higher HBM bandwidth than the 300, with lab testing complete.
key_facts.excerpt: MTIA 300 is in production for R&R training. MTIA 400 delivers 400% higher FP8 FLOPS than MTIA 300; 51% higher HBM bandwidth.

key_facts.fact: The MTIA 450, scheduled for early 2027, doubles HBM bandwidth from the 400 and delivers 75% higher MX4 FLOPS with custom low-precision data types. The MTIA 500 uses a 2x2 compute chiplet design with 50% higher HBM bandwidth and 43% higher MX4 FLOPS than the 450.
key_facts.excerpt: MTIA 450: Doubled HBM bandwidth from MTIA 400; 75% higher MX4 FLOPS; custom low-precision data types. MTIA 500: 50% higher HBM bandwidth than MTIA 450; up to 80% higher capacity; 43% higher MX4 FLOPS. 2x2 compute chiplet configuration.

key_facts.fact: From MTIA 300 to MTIA 500, HBM bandwidth grows 4.5x and compute FLOPS grows 25x. Meta emphasizes a roughly six-month cadence per chip generation, with inference-first optimization and PyTorch-native software integration.
key_facts.excerpt: HBM bandwidth increase: 4.5x. Compute FLOPS increase: 25x. High-velocity iterative development (~six months per generation), inference-first optimization, and PyTorch-native software integration.

stories.headline: Google releases Gemini Embedding 2, its first natively multimodal embedding model

key_facts.fact: The model succeeds the text-only gemini-embedding-001 and is available via the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Vertex AI, supporting over 100 languages and enabling cross-modal retrieval for RAG, semantic search, and classification.
key_facts.excerpt: Expanding on our previous text-only foundation, Gemini Embedding 2 maps text, images, videos, audio and documents into a single, unified embedding space, and captures semantic intent across over 100 languages.

key_facts.fact: VentureBeat reported the model reduces latency by as much as 70% for some enterprise customers and lowers total cost for enterprises using RAG-powered AI systems.

stories.headline: DeepMind marks AlphaGo's 10th anniversary as Hassabis lays out path to AGI

key_facts.fact: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis published a blog post on March 10 marking the 10th anniversary of AlphaGo's victory over world champion Lee Sedol, calling it the beginning of the modern AI era.
key_facts.excerpt: Ten years ago, our AI system AlphaGo became the first program to defeat a world champion at the complex game of Go – reaching a milestone in the field a decade before many experts thought possible.

key_facts.fact: Hassabis made DeepMind's AGI strategy explicit: combine Gemini's multimodal world models, AlphaGo's search and planning techniques, and specialized AI tools like AlphaFold into a unified system.
key_facts.excerpt: Today, this breakthrough continues to inform our work building systems on the path to artificial general intelligence (AGI). We believe AGI will be the most profound technology ever invented and potentially the ultimate tool to advance science, medicine, and productivity.

key_facts.fact: Hassabis reiterated DeepMind's AGI timeline estimate of around 2030, stating they are 'on a trajectory toward AGI around 2030' with a 50% probability within five years, requiring 'two or three big innovations' in multimodal models, reasoning, memory, and planning.
key_facts.excerpt: We are on a trajectory toward AGI around 2030.

stories.headline: UK council votes on 1GW Elsham data center campus that would emit 1M tonnes of CO2 per year

key_facts.fact: North Lincolnshire councillors are set to vote on March 11 on the Elsham Tech Park, a 1GW data center campus with peak annual Scope 2 emissions of 1,004,478 tonnes CO2 equivalent by 2033-34
key_facts.excerpt: North Lincolnshire councillors are set to vote tomorrow [Wednesday 11 March] on plans for a data centre which will cause one million tonnes of carbon dioxide emissions in a year.

key_facts.fact: The council report recommends 'minded to approve' and assessed the emissions as 'not significant' by comparing one facility against the entirety of UK carbon budgets
key_facts.excerpt: A council report, which recommends that councillors should be 'minded to approve' the planning application, states that 'peak annual Scope 2 emissions' caused by the data centre will reach 1,004,478 tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent (tCO2e) in the year 2033-34.

key_facts.fact: Tech justice nonprofit Foxglove accused the council of comparing one year of data center emissions against five years of UK totals, calling the methodology 'both mistaken and deeply misleading'
key_facts.excerpt: Foxglove has described as 'both mistaken and deeply misleading.' The council allegedly compared 'one year of the data centre's emissions against five years of the UK's total emissions.'

key_facts.fact: The campus would span 1.5 million sqm with 15 data halls, construction costs between £5.5-9 billion over a 10-year build, creating 650-1,000 full-time jobs
key_facts.excerpt: The campus would span 1.5 million sqm (16.1 million sq ft), making it one of the largest in the UK. It will feature 15 data halls with a combined power draw of 1GW.

key_facts.fact: The 1 million tonnes CO2 figure is almost equivalent to the total climate pollution from all UK domestic flights at 1.2 million tCO2e
key_facts.excerpt: The figure, which is almost equivalent to the total climate pollution caused by all of the UK's domestic flights (1.2m tCO2e), has been described in a council report as 'not significant'.

stories.headline: IEA agrees record 400 million barrel emergency oil release to counter Iran war price surge

key_facts.fact: The International Energy Agency agreed to release 400 million barrels of oil, the largest coordinated release in its history and only the sixth such move since its creation in the 1970s, backed unanimously by 32 member countries.
key_facts.excerpt: Members of the International Energy Agency have announced a coordinated release of 400 million barrels of stockpiled oil in an attempt to counter the disruption in oil trade triggered by the Iran war.

key_facts.fact: The release exceeds the 182 million barrels released in 2022 during Russia's invasion of Ukraine. IEA members collectively hold about 1.2 billion barrels in reserve plus 600 million barrels in industry stocks under government obligation.
key_facts.excerpt: They collectively hold about 1.2 billion barrels of oil in reserve. Another 600 million barrels are held in industry stocks under government obligation.

key_facts.fact: Oil prices dropped below $87/barrel on Tuesday night after hovering near $90, having spiked to nearly $120 late Sunday from pre-war levels around $70. IEA Executive Director Fatih Birol said 'the most important thing for a return to stable flows of oil and gas is the resumption of transit through the Strait of Hormuz.'
key_facts.excerpt: But to be clear, the most important thing for a return to stable flows of oil and gas is the resumption of transit through the Strait of Hormuz.

key_facts.fact: The IEA called an extraordinary meeting on March 10, with G7 energy ministers meeting earlier that day to discuss options. The US proposed a joint release of 300-400 million barrels.
key_facts.excerpt: The U.S. believes a joint release of 300 million to 400 million barrels...

stories.headline: Iran's new supreme leader Mojtaba Khamenei confirmed injured in Feb 28 strike, in hiding

key_facts.fact: An Iranian official told Reuters that newly appointed Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei was 'lightly injured but is continuing to operate.' He has not been seen publicly or issued any statement since his selection on Sunday, March 8.
key_facts.excerpt: Iran's newly-appointed Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei was lightly injured but is continuing to operate, an Iranian official told Reuters on Wednesday after state television described him as war wounded.

key_facts.fact: Three Iranian sources told the New York Times that Khamenei sustained wounds to his legs during the first day of the Israeli operation on February 28 and is hiding in a secure location with highly restricted communications.
key_facts.excerpt: The sources said he sustained wounds to his legs but remains conscious and is currently hiding in a secure location with highly restricted communications.

key_facts.fact: The first air strikes in the war killed Khamenei's father (Ayatollah Ali Khamenei), mother, sister, and wife. Iranian state TV called him 'the heir to the blood of his martyred father, his martyred mother, his martyred sister and his martyred wife.'
key_facts.excerpt: 'His Eminence Ayatollah Seyyed Mojtaba Khamenei is today the heir to the blood of his martyred father, his martyred mother, his martyred sister and his martyred wife,' a news anchor read out on state television.

key_facts.fact: Iranian president's son Yousef Pezeshkian said on Telegram on March 11 that Khamenei is 'safe and sound,' though analysts expect him to delegate power and remain out of public view due to assassination threats.
key_facts.excerpt: 'I heard news that Mr Mojtaba Khamenei had been injured. I have asked some friends who had connections. They told me that, thank God, he is safe and sound,' Mr Yousef Pezeshkian said in a post on his Telegram channel on March 11.

stories.headline: Oil crashes 10% from $120 peak as Trump signals Iran war 'ending soon'; markets stabilize

key_facts.fact: Crude oil plummeted roughly 10% to ~$85/barrel on March 10, down from near $120 the previous day, following Trump's statements that the conflict 'may be nearing its end' and pledging 'The Strait of Hormuz is going to remain safe.'
key_facts.excerpt: Crude oil plummeted 10% to $85 per barrel during midday New York trading, down from near $120 the previous day—a dramatic reversal following geopolitical tensions over the Strait of Hormuz closure.

key_facts.fact: The S&P 500 dipped 0.2%, the Dow fell 0.1% (34 points), and the Nasdaq edged higher by less than 0.1% on March 10 — a far calmer session than Monday's wild swings. The VIX dropped 9.3% to 23.
key_facts.excerpt: The S&P 500 dipped 0.2 per cent, a day after its latest wild swings caused by extreme moves in the oil market. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 34 points, or 0.1 per cent, and the Nasdaq composite edged higher by less than 0.1 per cent.

key_facts.fact: G7 energy ministers held a call on Tuesday, March 10, to discuss soaring energy prices, with French Finance Minister Roland Lescure saying there were 'currently no supply problems' in Europe or the US. G7 ministers said they 'stand ready' for 'all necessary measures' in coordination with the IEA.
key_facts.excerpt: G7 energy ministers will hold a call on Tuesday to discuss sharply rising energy prices triggered by the ongoing war in Iran.

key_facts.fact: Oracle stock jumped ~8% in after-hours trading on March 10 after beating Q3 estimates with revenue of $17.19 billion (up 21.7% YoY) and EPS of $1.79, the first time in 15+ years that both organic revenue and non-GAAP EPS grew 20%+ in the same quarter. Cloud revenue surged 44% to $8.9 billion.
key_facts.excerpt: This marks the first time in more than 15 years that Oracle's organic total revenue and non-GAAP earnings per share both grew by at least 20% in U.S. dollars during the same quarter.

stories.headline: DOJ probes Iran's use of Binance to evade sanctions and fund Houthi militants

key_facts.fact: The Wall Street Journal reported on March 11 that the US Justice Department is investigating whether Iran used Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, to evade sanctions and funnel over $1 billion to networks backing militant groups including Yemen's Houthis.
key_facts.excerpt: The US Justice Department has begun investigating Iran's alleged use of Binance to circumvent sanctions, especially funds transferred through the crypto exchange to finance terrorist organisations like Yemen's Houthi militants.

key_facts.fact: Authorities have contacted people with direct knowledge of the Iranian-linked transactions to request interviews and collect evidence. A Treasury-appointed monitor has asked Binance for details on the transactions.
key_facts.excerpt: Authorities have contacted people with direct knowledge of the Iranian-linked transactions to request interviews and collect evidence.

key_facts.fact: The probe follows an earlier letter from 11 Senate Banking Committee Democrats who cited reports of $1.7 billion in digital assets flowing to Iranian-linked terror entities via Binance, and alleged the company retaliated against compliance staff who flagged the transactions.
key_facts.excerpt: Eleven Democratic senators urged DOJ and Treasury to investigate Binance over alleged Iran sanctions violations in 2026. Binance compliance staff reportedly uncovered $1.7 billion in digital assets flowing to Iranian-linked terror entities.

key_facts.fact: On March 6, the DOJ separately filed civil forfeiture complaints against $15.3 million in funds allegedly linked to an illicit Iranian oil shipping network run by Mohammad Hossein Shamkhani, tied to the IRGC and IRGC Quds Force.
key_facts.excerpt: The Department of Justice filed two civil forfeiture complaints today in the U.S. District Court for the District of Columbia against more than $15.3 million allegedly used to fund an illicit Iranian oil distribution network.

stories.headline: Tech layoffs surpass 45,000 in early 2026 with AI linked to 20% of job cuts

key_facts.fact: An analysis by RationalFX found 45,363 tech job cuts globally so far in 2026, with roughly 68% (over 30,000) occurring in the United States. About 9,238 layoffs — approximately 20% — are tied to AI implementation and organizational restructuring.
key_facts.excerpt: A recent analysis by RationalFX found 45,363 job cuts globally so far this year—with roughly 68% or more than 30,000 occurring in the U.S.

key_facts.fact: Amazon leads with 16,000 layoffs (more than half of all tech cuts), followed by Block with 4,000 (40% workforce reduction), ams OSRAM with 2,000, Ericsson with 1,900, ASML with 1,700, Meta with ~1,500 (10% of Reality Labs), and Autodesk and Salesforce with ~1,000 each.
key_facts.excerpt: Amazon leads with the largest cuts: 16,000 layoffs announced in 2026.

key_facts.fact: Outplacement firm Challenger reported 33,330 tech layoffs in just January-February 2026 — a 51% increase from the year-earlier period. AI was cited in 12,304 US job cuts (8% of the total layoff figure across all industries).
key_facts.excerpt: The tech industry reported a total of 33,330 layoffs in the first two months of 2026 — a 51% increase from the year-earlier period, outplacement firm Challenger said.

key_facts.fact: Block CEO Jack Dorsey said the decision was 'not driven by financial difficulty, but by the growing capability of AI tools to perform a wider range of tasks.' Oracle is reportedly preparing cuts of 20,000-30,000 jobs per TD Cowen, which could free $6.2-7.7 billion in cash flow for AI infrastructure.
key_facts.excerpt: Oracle Corporation could cut between 20,000 and 30,000 jobs as the company expands its artificial intelligence infrastructure, according to a research report from investment bank TD Cowen.

stories.headline: Novo Nordisk's triple-agonist obesity drug UBT251 achieves 19.7% weight loss in China trial

key_facts.fact: UBT251, a triple-agonist (GLP-1/GIP/glucagon) obesity drug jointly developed by Novo Nordisk and United Laboratories International, achieved 19.7% average weight loss at the highest dose after 24 weeks in a mid-stage clinical trial conducted in China.
key_facts.excerpt: Novo Nordisk and United Laboratories report nearly 20% weight loss in a mid-stage trial of a next-gen triple-agonist therapy.

key_facts.fact: The placebo group lost only about 2% body weight, meaning UBT251 patients lost close to one-fifth of their body weight — more than 17 kilograms in under six months via once-weekly injections.
key_facts.excerpt: While those on placebo lost about 2% of their body weight, those on UBT251 lost close to a fifth. For many participants, that meant shedding more than 17 kilograms in under six months.

key_facts.fact: UBT251 belongs to the 'triple G' class targeting GLP-1, GIP, and glucagon receptors simultaneously, representing the next generation beyond current blockbuster obesity drugs like semaglutide and tirzepatide.
key_facts.excerpt: UBT251 belongs to a newer category of treatments known as triple agonists, sometimes referred to as 'triple G' drugs.

stories.headline: Aptevo's mipletamig shows 86% clinical benefit rate with zero CRS in frontline AML

key_facts.fact: Aptevo Therapeutics reported that mipletamig combined with venetoclax and azacitidine achieved an 86% clinical benefit rate (CR/CRi/PR) in 28 evaluable frontline AML patients, with zero cases of cytokine release syndrome (CRS).
key_facts.excerpt: The combination has demonstrated robust clinical activity, delivering an 86% clinical benefit rate (CR/CRi/PR) with zero patients experiencing the common symptom of cytokine release syndrome (CRS).

key_facts.fact: Among the 28 evaluable patients from two trials (including the Phase 1b/2 RAINIER trial), 79% achieved CR or CRi, 61% achieved complete remission, and 55% of CR/CRi patients reached MRD-negative status — a marker linked to more durable responses.
key_facts.excerpt: Among 28 evaluable patients... the mipletamig regimen produced a clinical benefit rate (CBR) of 86%. Additionally, 79% of patients experienced a complete remission (CR) or CR with incomplete hematologic recovery (CRi), and 61% had a CR.

key_facts.fact: 35% of remissions occurred in patients with TP53 mutations, a high-risk subgroup known for poor prognosis. Mipletamig is a first-in-class CD123 x CD3 bispecific antibody built on Aptevo's proprietary ADAPTIR platform.
key_facts.excerpt: 35% of remissions occurred in patients with TP53 mutations, a high-risk subgroup with poor prognosis.

stories.headline: Google completes $32 billion Wiz acquisition, its largest deal ever

key_facts.fact: Google announced on March 11 that it completed its all-cash $32 billion acquisition of Israeli cybersecurity startup Wiz, the largest acquisition in Google's history and one of the biggest-ever cybersecurity deals.
key_facts.excerpt: Google's biggest acquisition yet for Israeli cybersecurity firm.

key_facts.fact: Wiz will be integrated into Google Cloud but will continue operating under its own brand and remain compatible with other major cloud platforms including AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Oracle Cloud.
key_facts.excerpt: The cloud security specialist will continue to operate under its own brand and across multiple platforms.

key_facts.fact: The deal was first announced in July 2024 and required multiple antitrust regulatory approvals. The completion is expected to channel an estimated NIS 10 billion ($3.2 billion) in tax proceeds to Israel's coffers, as the four founders and many employees are Israeli residents.
key_facts.excerpt: The completion of the transaction is expected to funnel an estimated NIS 10 billion ($3.2 billion) into Israel's state coffers in tax proceeds, as the four founders of Wiz and many of its employees are Israeli residents.

key_facts.fact: The $3.2 billion tax revenue comes as Israel's finances are strained by higher military spending amid the ongoing war with Iran, making this the largest-ever exit for an Israeli-founded tech company.
key_facts.excerpt: The tax revenue injection comes as Israel's finances are being further strained by higher military spending needs amid the ongoing war with Iran.
